steps.en: Install the library plus its default styling engine, Emotion
steps.zh: 装上组件库和它默认的样式引擎 Emotion

steps.en: Put your brand colors, type and spacing into one theme and wrap the app
steps.zh: 把品牌色、字体、间距写进一个主题，包住整个应用

steps.en: Import finished components and pick variants through props
steps.zh: 导入现成组件，用 props 选样式变体

steps.en: Each component reads the theme and generates its own CSS at runtime
steps.zh: 每个组件读取主题，运行时生成自己的 CSS

steps.en: Handles keyboard, focus, ARIA and responsive layout inside every component
steps.zh: 键盘、焦点、ARIA 和响应式布局都在组件内部处理好

value.en: A complete, consistent Material-style UI without designing or styling each widget yourself
value.zh: 整套风格一致的 Material 界面，不用自己逐个设计、写样式

sources: https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/master/docs/data/material/getting-started/installation/installation.md (npm install @mui/material @emotion/react @emotion/styled; Emotion is the default styling engine)
